lines.beaver_en: Hello. How have you been eating lately?
lines.learner: 일하랴 아이 보랴 밥 먹을 시간이 없어요.
lines.en: Between work and the kids, I have no time to eat.
lines.roman: ilharya ai borya bap meogeul sigani eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then do you often skip meals?
lines.en: Yes, I skip breakfast almost every day.

lines.beaver_en: That'll wear you down. What about lunch?
lines.en: Afraid of being late for meetings, I just gulp down bread.

lines.beaver_en: You shouldn't do that. How about dinner?
lines.learner: 하루 종일 굶다가 밤에 많이 먹어요.
lines.en: I go hungry all day, then eat a lot at night.
lines.roman: haru jongil gumdaga bame mani meogeoyo.

lines.en: Yes, so I want to lose weight.

lines.beaver_en: How many vegetables do you eat?
lines.learner: 거의 안 먹어요. 섬유질이 부족할 거예요.
lines.en: Hardly any. I probably lack fiber.
lines.roman: geoui an meogeoyo. seomyujiri bujokal geoyeyo.

lines.en: No, I don't get enough fluids either.

lines.beaver: 평소 식습관에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about your usual eating habits?
lines.beaver_roman: pyeongso sikseupgwane daehae deo malsseumhae jusigesseoyo?
lines.learner: 웰빙이 중요한 건 알지만 실천이 어려워요.
lines.en: I know well-being matters, but it's hard to practice.
lines.roman: welbingi jungyohan geon aljiman silcheoni eoryeowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: For busy people, a simple diet plan is best.
lines.learner: 장소를 불문하고 먹을 수 있는 식단이면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: I'd like a diet I can follow anywhere.
lines.roman: jangsoreul bulmunhago meogeul su inneun sikdanimyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Always carry nuts and a water bottle.
lines.learner: 네, 설령 바빠도 아침은 거르지 않을게요.
lines.en: Okay, even if I'm busy, I won't skip breakfast.
lines.roman: ne, seollyeong bappado achimeun georeuji aneulkkeyo.
